entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: Vedalken lord, Mirrodin's most respected vedalken researcher, who became a zealous agent of Memnarch then betrayed him.

entities.name: Donal
entities.description: Pontifex's test subject and father of Bruenna.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: Daughter of Donal who ran into Pontifex in Lumengrid.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Elf whom Pontifex saw as a threat and pursued.

entities.name: Synod
entities.description: Vedalken council to which Pontifex belonged.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Place where Pontifex took Bruenna and Glissa in.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Master Pontifex served and then sought to usurp.

entities.name: Marek
entities.description: Pontifex's companion who killed him and was killed in turn.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: Site of Pontifex's assault on Glissa's band.

entities.name: Kaldra
entities.description: Awoke and shattered the battlefield, forcing Pontifex to retreat.

entities.name: Sawtooth thresher battalion
entities.description: Forces Pontifex dispatched to intercept Glissa.

events.summary: Pontifex agrees to the council's wish to kill his subject Donal to gain favor with the Synod.
events.quote: He agreed to this to gain favor with the Synod

events.summary: Pontifex takes Bruenna and Glissa into his house as guests/prisoners to hand them over for a council seat.
events.quote: he took them into his house as guests/prisoners to hand them over for a council seat

events.summary: Pontifex orders Marek to execute Glissa in the Razor Fields, against Memnarch's command.
events.quote: where he ordered his companion Marek to execute the elf

events.summary: Pontifex ambushes Glissa at the Vault of Whispers but retreats when Kaldra awakens.
events.quote: thwarted by the awakening of Kaldra

events.summary: Pontifex descends into Mirrodin's Core and sends a sawtooth thresher battalion after Glissa, seeking to usurp Memnarch.
events.quote: he sought not to fulfill Memnarch’s will, but to usurp it

events.summary: Marek and Pontifex kill each other when Pontifex prepares to kill Glissa.
events.quote: Marek managed to wound Pontifex fatally, the vedalken struck back with his blade launchers, killing Marek in the same instant

relations.quote: Pontifex, once a revered member of the vedalken Synod

relations.note: Agent who later sought to usurp him.
relations.quote: became one of the most zealous and dangerous agents in service to Memnarch
Pontifex took special interest in Glissa
Marek managed to wound Pontifex fatally

relations.note: Killed him in the same instant.
relations.quote: killing Marek in the same instant
Pontifex was the owner of Donal , the father of Bruenna .
